system.description:
When ensorcelled with this spell, the traveler leaves no trace of his passage. Success adds a +1 Ob penalty to anyone attempting to track or stalk this wolf. Each success over the obstacle increases the penalty by one.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 4.

Origin: Presence | Area of Effect: Caster or Single Target | Element: Earth | Impetus: Influence | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 12

Dire Haunt spell, cast with Tongue of the Ancient One (the wolf equivalent of Sorcery).

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 503
